comparison.objective: Arrange or load a trailer in a sixty-forty configuration, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bulk placement and load-distribution handling versus precise tool engagement, rotary tuning, counterholding, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: A 60/40 arrangement is title-implied; no body/specs, load definition, balance tolerance, or safety rubric is supplied. Candidate uses explicit dynamic-stop and retention checks.
comparison.reason: Load arrangement does not test fine mechanical calibration or impact-response iteration.
